reviewer: scanner_integration independent source review; did not perform the original Codacy inventory triage
method: Read all five selected test files at the immutable reviewed revision.
Traced each reported argument to fixture creation, fixed literal sets and private helper call sites; inspected surrounding assertions and cleanup.
Verified original scan source SHA-256 and each original sink against Git blobs; separately bound unchanged sink lines to reviewed Git source hashes.
limitations: This is a source review of exactly the listed 40 occurrence IDs, not a general exemption for tests or rules.
No fresh Codacy scan, platform ignore or closure was applied. Remaining 199 proposals need independent review.
No test or production source was modified for this review, and no test execution is claimed as evidence for these review decisions.
Private local fixture ownership is the path-traversal threat model; this review does not establish resistance to a hostile process already executing as the same OS user.
